svg.title: British Columbia Housing Management Commission, 1978: full logo
svg.desc: A manual vector reconstruction from the supplied 1978 annual report. The monogram uses two purpose-drawn filled paths with a transparent B counter and roof slit. The three-line name uses outlined Nimbus Sans Bold, optically fitted; the original historical typeface is unverified. Brown is an approximation sampled from the report scan, not a verified official colour specification. No embedded raster images, live fonts, strokes, filters, or external dependencies. Reconstructed 2026-11-12.
